ui.linia: Reusable investor pitch for AI-native ventures. It must move from customer pain and product insight through market logic, business model, evidence, defensibility, go-to-market, financial case, risks, team, funding ask and explicit milestones. Each slide should communicate one thesis and distinguish verified facts from management hypotheses.
Evidence-governed assessment readout linking maturity scores and confidence to gaps, root causes, recommendations and a sequenced transformation roadmap.
Decision-led steering deck with reconciled performance, value, milestones, dependencies, residual risk and explicit committee asks.
Investor-grade valuation decision pack with reconciled financials, methodology, scenario sensitivity, comparable evidence, risk and explicit transaction next steps.
Board decision deck requiring verified value, delivery, risk, options, recommendation, accountable owner and decision deadline.

Board-ready investment decision template for automation programs. Must support an executive recommendation, investment economics, scenario comparison, phased roadmap, risk heatmap, governance and a clear decision ask. Use sources only in speaker notes and metadata, never as visible canvas labels.
Summary of consulting tool session results, insights, and recommended actions.
Operational update on execution progress, delays, budget status, and team delivery.
